Site: Fabric Care Guide
URL: https://www.fabriccare.guide

Purpose:
Evidence-based guidance on removing red wine stains from fabrics and household textiles.

Scope:
- Red wine stains on clothing, upholstery, rugs, and linens
- Immediate triage, same-day treatment, and escalation decisions

Content Structure:
- Answer-first pages
- Step-by-step methods
- What to avoid
- Material-specific guidance
